# Evaluation Snapshot

## Prompt
Compare creating a durable repo-local decision record with only finding existing rationale and choose the clearer fit after a real new route choice was made.

## Expected selection
use

## Why
The task has a new durable choice that future agents need to find.

## Expected object
A source-owned decision record creation route with local index rebuild and graph refresh.

## Boundary notes
This is an aoa-decision-create case, not an aoa-decision-find case.

## Verification hooks
- write the source decision note
- rebuild local indexes
- refresh or check the workspace graph
